title: Lingashtakam Lyrics with Meaning in English: Verse 9
desc: Lingashtakam verse with Sanskrit text and a simple English meaning. Chant on Mondays and Maha Shivaratri.
alt: Lord Shiva, Lingashtakam with English meaning
caption: Lingashtakam: one verse with its meaning.
intro: **Lingashtakam** is among the most loved Shiva hymns. This post gives one verse in Sanskrit with its **meaning in simple English**.
takeaways: Mondays and Pradosham are the usual days for Shiva stotras.
Bilva leaves, water and a lamp are the simple offerings.
Understand the meaning and the chant becomes prayer.

p: **लिङ्गाष्टकमिदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ ।** **शिवलोकमवाप्नोति शिवेन सह मोदते ॥**
This Lingashtakam gives merit. One who recites it in the presence of Shiva reaches the world of Shiva and rejoices with him.
Sit quietly, take three slow breaths and chant the verse once aloud, then once in the mind. Do the whole hymn on Mondays, one verse on other days.

faq.q: What is the meaning of this Lingashtakam verse?
faq.a: This Lingashtakam gives merit. One who recites it in the presence of Shiva reaches the world of Shiva and rejoices with him.

faq.q: When should I chant Shiva stotras?
faq.a: **Mondays**, **Pradosham** and **Maha Shivaratri** are the traditional times.

note: The Sanskrit is the traditional text. The English is our own plain rendering.
